```plato

    // The live slot of the ring through `head` whose point is leftmost.
    LeftmostSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, head: Integer): Integer
    {
        var best = head;
        var slot = nodes.At(head).Next;
        while (slot != head)
        {
            if (points.NodePoint(nodes, slot).IsFurtherLeft(points.NodePoint(nodes, best)))
            {
                best = slot;
            }
            slot = nodes.At(slot).Next;
        }
        return best;
    }
```
